Confirming — the meeting was created with an ampersand-heavy query string for the OAuth host token (used for automatic join and dial-in). Outlook forwards will indeed trim that. There are three practical options: 

1) Regenerate invite with canonical zoom.us/j/<meeting-id> + passcode in the body (no token query) — broad compatibility.
2) Send a direct one-click Zoom shortlink (zoom.us/w/...) — may still be parsed but often survives forwards.
3) Offer a temporary Webex fallback link as a last resort (we have an open Webex slot).

I recommend option 1 for speed. I'll generate a new invite and a one-line email with the plain join URL and passcode. Also attaching a repro screenshot I captured showing the query string cut off.

Attachments: repro-query-strip.png
